items.question: A 24 h probe comparing a rebuilt raw order book with 100 ms snapshots logged 29 unexplained 'prior' mismatches (0 of 156,319 exact checks mismatched) but kept only a counter, so no mismatch can be classified as a timing artefact or a rebuild error. A ruling requires all to be shown artefacts before any verdict. What now?

options.label: (a)
options.text: add per-mismatch logging and a reconnect-reset fix, re-run 24 h on a temporary cloud box before 2026-10-14, then diagnose and read

options.label: (b)
options.text: accept the class-level evidence and run the read on the existing data, relaxing the ruling

items.rationale: (a) records the per-mismatch evidence the ruling requires and fixes a probe defect; it fits before the 6-week holiday (about 1 build session + 24 h + 1 read). (b) gives up the guarantee the ruling set; (c) leaves the absorption build gated for 7+ weeks.
